title: Fast Food Highway
description: A vibrant surreal scene shows a winding highway with a black Cadillac Escalade, red Ford Mustang, and dark SUV driving through rolling green hills. In the background stand giant McDonald's golden arches, a Hooters restaurant, and a massive billboard featuring a red cup and stylized face, with oversized burgers and fries displayed on the roadside.
prompt: Surreal digital painting of a winding highway cutting through rolling green and purple hills at dusk. A black Cadillac Escalade, red Ford Mustang, and dark SUV drive along the glowing road. Giant McDonald's golden arches and a Hooters restaurant sit beside the highway with massive burgers, fries, and a steaming Hooters table in the foreground. A large billboard displays a red soda cup and stylized face against a purple sky, whimsical consumer culture scene.
